# Changelog

Semua perubahan penting di project ini akan didokumentasikan di sini.

Format berdasarkan [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
dan project ini patuh ke [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.0.0] - 2026-09-04

### Added

- Initial release
- Windows Server 2022 RDP workflow
- Custom user `Xydesk` dengan admin privileges
- Pre-installed dev environment:
  - Node.js 24 LTS, Python 3.13, Go 1.25, Rust 1.91
  - Java 25 LTS, .NET 9, PHP 8.4, Ruby 3.4
  - C++ Build Tools, CMake, Ninja
  - Visual Studio Code + 11 extensions
  - Git, GitHub CLI, Docker Desktop
  - Chrome, Postman, 7-Zip
- Cloudflare Tunnel integration (opsional)
- Tailscale integration (opsional)
- Ollama + LLM models (opsional)
- Custom Xydesk theme (wallpaper, dark mode)
- Security hardening (TLS 1.3, firewall, account lockout)
- Cloudflare Access + Google OAuth setup guide
- Comprehensive documentation (README, SETUP-GUIDE, VERSI-TERBARU)
- Issue templates (bug report, feature request)
- Pull request template
- Dependabot configuration
- Security policy
- Code owners
- GitHub Actions badges
